vision: Empower users to create, share, and analyze custom forms effortlessly through an intuitive drag-and-drop interface built with React DnD, storing data securely in PostgreSQL and enabling insights through CSV export and basic analytics.
scope: The epic covers design and implementation of a web-based form builder with drag-and-drop field creation, form persistence, public sharing via links, response collection, analytics dashboard, and CSV export. Out of scope: advanced analytics, authentication, and form embedding in external sites.
success_criteria: Users can create and save custom forms with at least six types of fields.
Users can share forms through unique links and export responses as CSV.

user_stories.title: Create drag-and-drop form editor using React DnD
user_stories.i_want: to build a form by dragging and arranging available field types
user_stories.so_that: I can easily design custom forms without coding

acceptance_criteria.given: a user is on the form editor page
acceptance_criteria.when: they drag a field type into the form area
acceptance_criteria.then: the new field appears in the form layout

user_stories.title: Persist created forms in PostgreSQL database
user_stories.i_want: to store form definitions and field configurations
user_stories.so_that: users can retrieve, update, or share their saved forms

acceptance_criteria.given: a form is created and saved
acceptance_criteria.when: the user refreshes or reopens the editor
acceptance_criteria.then: the previously saved form structure is loaded from the database

user_stories.title: Generate shareable form link for response collection
user_stories.i_want: to share my created form via a unique link
user_stories.so_that: respondents can fill out the form easily

acceptance_criteria.then: a unique URL is generated for public access to the form

user_stories.title: Collect and store form responses in PostgreSQL
user_stories.i_want: to submit answers to shared forms
user_stories.so_that: form creators can view collected data and analyze results

acceptance_criteria.given: a respondent opens a shared form
acceptance_criteria.when: they fill and submit the form
acceptance_criteria.then: each response is validated and stored in PostgreSQL

user_stories.title: Export collected responses to CSV format
user_stories.i_want: to download collected form responses in CSV format
user_stories.so_that: I can analyze data offline or in other tools

acceptance_criteria.then: a CSV file containing all responses is generated and downloaded

user_stories.title: Provide basic analytics dashboard for form responses
user_stories.i_want: to view aggregated metrics like total submissions and field-based insights
user_stories.so_that: I can understand response trends easily

acceptance_criteria.when: the user opens the analytics dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: summary metrics and visual charts are displayed based on the data
